headline: IndiGo Flight From Bengaluru To Lucknow Returns Over Hijack Threat
seoTitle: IndiGo Flight Returns to Bengaluru After Hijack Threat
metaDescription: An IndiGo flight traveling from Bengaluru to Lucknow returned to the airport after crew members discovered a written threat regarding a hijack attempt.
aiSummaryBullets: An IndiGo aircraft en route to Lucknow returned to Kempegowda International Airport shortly after takeoff.
The decision followed the discovery of a note in an aircraft restroom warning of a planned hijacking at 6:30.
Security agencies performed a mandatory safety inspection on the plane after the pilot initiated an emergency return.
aiContextParagraph: The incident involved IndiGo flight 6E-451, which departed from Terminal 1 of the Kempegowda International Airport in Bengaluru with a destination of Lucknow. Approximately thirty minutes into the journey, cabin crew members discovered a handwritten note located inside the aircraft toilet. The message claimed that the aircraft would be hijacked at 6:30 and contained a warning regarding the consequences of ignoring the statement. Upon being notified of the discovery, the pilot elected to turn the flight around to return to the point of origin for security assessment. Once the plane landed back at Kempegowda International Airport, security personnel conducted a comprehensive sweep of the vessel. The situation caused operational delays as authorities evaluated the potential threat level posed by the discovery, ensuring that all safety protocols were followed for the passengers and crew aboard.
whyItIsViral: The story gained traction through reports from two major independent news outlets covering the mid-air security protocol and the resulting operational disruption.
